hebrewText: גָּ֣רֵֽשׁ לֵ֭ץ וְ/יֵצֵ֣א מָד֑וֹן וְ֝/יִשְׁבֹּ֗ת דִּ֣ין וְ/קָלֽוֹן

tokens.bdb: to drive out from a possession; especially to expatriate or divorce
tokens.kjv: cast up (out), divorced (woman), drive away (forth, out), expel, [idiom] surely put away, trouble, thrust out.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to drive out from a possession; especially to expatriate or divorce
tokens.enLiteralWord: to drive out from a possession; especially to expatriate or divorce
tokens.explanation: to drive out from a possession; especially to expatriate or divorce
tokens.explanationEn: to drive out from a possession; especially to expatriate or divorce

tokens.bdb: properly, to make mouths at, i.e. to scoff; hence (from the effort to pronounce a foreign language) to interpret, or (generally) intercede
tokens.kjv: ambassador, have in derision, interpreter, make a mock, mocker, scorn(-er, -ful), teacher.

tokens.bdb: to go (causatively, bring) out, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively, direct and proxim.
tokens.kjv: [idiom] after, appear, [idiom] assuredly, bear out, [idiom] begotten, break out, bring forth (out, up), carry out, come (abroad, out, thereat, without), [phrase] be condemned, depart(-ing, -ure), draw forth, in the end, escape, exact, fail, fall (out), fetch forth (out), get away (forth, hence, out), (able to, cause to, let) go abroad (forth, on, out), going out, grow, have forth (out), issue out, lay (lie) out, lead out, pluck out, proceed, pull out, put away, be risen, [idiom] scarce, send with commandment, shoot forth, spread, spring out, stand out, [idiom] still, [idiom] surely, take forth (out), at any time, [idiom] to (and fro), utter.
brawling, contention(-ous), discord, strife. Compare H4079 (מִדְיָן), H4090 (מְדָן).

tokens.bdb: to repose, i.e. desist from exertion; used in many implied relations (causative, figurative or specific)
tokens.kjv: (cause to, let, make to) cease, celebrate, cause (make) to fail, keep (sabbath), suffer to be lacking, leave, put away (down), (make to) rest, rid, still, take away.

tokens.bdb: judgement (the suit, justice, sentence or tribunal); by implication also strife
